welcome.lead: Four short questions: language, how to connect, mode and protection. Nothing is applied before the last step, and you can change everything later in Settings.
welcome.note: The language switches right away. «Skip» saves only the language and leaves everything else at its default.

connect.title: How to connect
connect.lead: The tunnel needs a way out: your own servers from a key or subscription, or the local proxy of a VPN client already running on this computer.
connect.keyText: Your own servers: a vless://, trojan://, ss://… link or a subscription link. The app connects to them itself.
connect.proxyText: Through another VPN client on this computer (Happ, for example): its SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy on 127.0.0.1.
connect.keyHint: Optional: you can add servers later on the Servers page. The key joins the list only after «Finish».
connect.keyHintHasServers_one: Optional: {{count}} server is already in the list. A new key is added to it after «Finish».
connect.keyHintHasServers_few: Optional: {{count}} servers are already in the list. A new key is added to them after «Finish».
connect.keyHintHasServers_many: Optional: {{count}} servers are already in the list. A new key is added to them after «Finish».
connect.keyHintHasServers_other: Optional: {{count}} servers are already in the list. A new key is added to them after «Finish».
connect.keyEmpty: Paste a key or a subscription link first
connect.searching: Looking for a VPN client's proxy on this computer…
connect.proxyFound: Found the proxy {{proxy}}. The connection will go through it.
connect.proxyNotFound: No proxy found. Start your VPN client and press «Search again» — or go on: you can enter the proxy address later in Settings.

routing.title: Mode
routing.hardText: All Windows traffic goes through the tunnel: browsers, games, updates, any program.
routing.softText: No TUN: programs are given the proxy address through environment variables. Only the programs that honour them use the tunnel.
routing.softNeedsProxy: Soft works only through a local proxy: with a key the connection always uses TUN.

protection.title: Protection
protection.lead: Optional. The Kill-Switch is off by default: turn it on if traffic outside the VPN is unacceptable even for a minute.

done.title: All set
done.lead: Check your choices. «Finish» applies everything in one go; if something fails, the wizard stays open and shows why.
done.keyExisting_one: Key or subscription: {{count}} server in the list
done.keyExisting_few: Key or subscription: {{count}} servers in the list
done.keyExisting_many: Key or subscription: {{count}} servers in the list
done.keyExisting_other: Key or subscription: {{count}} servers in the list
done.keyLater: Key or subscription: add servers later on the Servers page
done.keyUnchecked: The pasted key was not checked and will not be added. Go back to step 2 and press «Check».
done.waitCheck: Wait until the key check is over

error.autostartNotRestored: Setup was not completed, and autostart could not be put back as it was. Check autostart in Settings.
error.killSwitchNotRestored: Setup was not completed, and the previous Kill-Switch level could not be put back. Check it in Settings.

demo.diskFull: Settings could not be saved: the disk is full.
demo.subscriptionDown: The subscription server did not answer. Check the link and your internet connection.
